name: stepper
description: Step indicator for multi-step flows: numbered circles, connectors and labels, horizontal or vertical, with completed, current, error and optional steps, screen-reader state text, and clickable link or button steps

changes.note: Additive. A step can be data-state="error" (the destructive pair and an exclamation mark); a completed step now draws a tick whatever its indicator holds, so a reactive wizard's numbers turn into ticks with no markup change. New parts: description (a second line), optional (the "Optional" marker) and status (the state in words, visually hidden — "Completed", "Error"). aria-current="step" marks the current step, gives it a halo, and keeps its label on a phone, where the other labels still hide. Steps may be <a> or <button> — hit area, hover, focus ring, a disabled step keeps the pending look — so a stepper can drive a wizard. The vertical variant shows labels and second lines at every width. An <ol> root with <li> steps is the progress-list shape. Existing markup renders as before apart from the tick in completed steps.

Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached the steps, connectors, indicators and labels with descendant selectors, so a component in a step with a label part took the step label's size and colour. Parts are root > step > indicator and label, and root > connector. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

The label/connector responsive rule is mobile-first on the breakpoint canon: labels are hidden in the base and revealed from sm (40rem) up, and the connector's tight phone metrics are the base rather than an override. Identical design at the identical threshold; the boundary moves to the wide side, so at exactly 640px labels now show.

step.description: Individual step container: a div or li to display progress, an a or button to navigate to the step (disable the ones that cannot be reached yet)

indicator.description: Numbered circle; a completed step draws a tick and an error step an exclamation mark over its number

label.description: Step label text. Hidden below sm in the horizontal layout except on the aria-current step; always shown in the vertical layout

description.description: Second line under the label: a summary, a hint, an error message (destructive on an error step)

optional.description: The optional marker: visible text ("Optional") on its own line under the label, read with the step

status.description: The step's state in words for screen readers only ("Completed", "Error"), visually hidden; the current step needs none, aria-current says it

connector.description: Line connecting steps (an aria-hidden li in an ol)

active.description: The current step: solid primary fill and a halo. Pair it with aria-current="step"

completed.description: A finished step (and, on a connector, a finished stretch): the success tint and a tick

error.description: A step that needs attention: the destructive fill and an exclamation mark; with aria-current it keeps a halo in the destructive tint

keyboard.Tab: clickable steps: move between the steps that can be reached (disabled steps are skipped)
keyboard.Enter: clickable steps: go to the focused step
keyboard.Space: button steps: go to the focused step

notes: A stepper that navigates is role="navigation" (or a nav) with an aria-label, and its steps are links or buttons; one that only shows progress can be an ol with an aria-label, its steps li and its connectors aria-hidden li.
aria-current="step" goes on the current step, whichever its data-state.
The tick and exclamation mark are drawn, not read: put "Completed" or "Error" in a status part so a screen reader hears the state. The optional part is visible text and is read as it is.
Steps that cannot be reached yet are disabled (a button) or aria-disabled (a link without href), never only greyed out.

safe_transforms: Change step data-state to active, completed or error
Add a description, optional or status part to a step
Make steps buttons or links, disabling the ones not reachable yet
Move aria-current="step" with the current step
unsafe_transforms: Show a state by colour alone, without a status part
Leave an unreachable button or link step enabled
tests: Error state draws the destructive pair and an exclamation mark
aria-current step keeps its label on a phone
Status part is visually hidden and read
Button steps have a focus ring and disabled steps stay pending
Clicking a completed stepper step drives the wizard back to its panel
